extDesc.message: Lets Kiki on this Mac use this Chrome profile (one account per profile).

stWaiting.message: Waiting for you to allow it in Kiki

badName.message: Names can only use letters, digits, - and _, up to 40 characters

slow.message: Still not connected after 10 seconds: make sure Kiki is running on this computer and up to date

phName.message: Leave empty and Kiki picks a name

hintName.message: Letters, digits, - and _ only. You can also change it when you allow it in Kiki.

hintAuto.message: Once installed it finds Kiki by itself: allow it in Kiki → Settings → Browsers and you're connected.

hintServer.message: Kiki on another computer: enter the “Other computers use” address from Kiki → Settings → Browsers.

phToken.message: Copy it from Kiki → Settings → Browsers

hintToken.message: Use it when clicking Allow is inconvenient. Only works on the computer running Kiki.

close4001.message: Wrong pairing code: copy it again from Kiki → Settings → Browsers

close4002.message: That name won't work: use only letters, digits, - and _

close4003.message: Removed in Kiki. Click Connect to ask again

close4004.message: Another profile already uses this name. Pick a different one

close4005.message: Declined in Kiki. To connect, click Connect to ask again

close4006.message: Too many browsers are waiting in Kiki. Deal with them in Kiki → Settings → Browsers first

close4007.message: The pairing code only works on the computer running Kiki. On other computers clear it, click Connect, then allow it in Kiki

oldKiki.message: This Kiki version can't approve browsers yet: update Kiki, or enter the pairing code under Advanced

badServer.message: Wrong Kiki address. It should look like ws://127.0.0.1:4567/ext

cantReach.message: Can't reach Kiki: make sure Kiki is running and the address is right

detailSep.description: Between a status and its reason
